title: Pyridin-3-carbohydrazide strongly impairs Mayaro and Chikungunya virus replication in vitro
abstract: Abstract Alphaviruses, including Mayaro virus (MAYV) and Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), pose a growing public health threat, with increasing reports worldwide and no licensed antiviral treatments available. This study evaluated the antiviral activity of pyridine-3-carbohydrazide (P-3-C) against MAYV (strains BeAr and TRVL) and CHIKV (strain La Reunion, LR). Vero E6 or U-2OS cells were infected and treated with P-3-C for 24 h, and cell viability and replication levels were assessed. The 50% cytotoxic concentration (CC 50 ), 50% effective concentration (EC 50 ), and selective index (SI) were calculated. P-3-C showed concentration-dependent activity, strongly inhibiting post-entry stages of MAYV BeAr replication. Treatment reduced intracellular viral RNA levels by 2 log 10 compared with controls and effectively decreased viral RNA release. P-3-C also inhibited MAYV TRVL (SI > 29.4) and CHIKV LR (SI > 48.8) in Vero E6 cells and retained selectivity in U-2OS cells (SI = 3.9 and 6.4, respectively). In a CHIKV U-2OS subgenomic replicon, an SI of 4.1 was found. Additionally, Fluorometric FRET-Based and MicroScale Thermophoresis (MST) assays indicated that P-3-C inhibited the nsP2 protease activity (IC 50 = 12 μM ± 2) and exhibited binding affinity for nsP4 polymerase ( K d = 54 μM ± 1) from CHIKV, thereby suggesting that these non-structural proteins are potential molecular targets. Molecular docking positioned P-3-C within the catalytic pockets of nsP2 and nsP4 of both viruses. Overall, the data suggest that P-3-C exhibits a potential multitarget mechanism of action and highlight its antiviral activity against different alphavirus strains; however, this efficacy could be dependent on the cell line used.
authors: Maria Eduarda Trevisan Aguillar da Silva

analysis.research_question_and_background: Alphaviruses such as Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) are expanding globally and remain without licensed antiviral therapies, creating an urgent need for effective antiviral agents.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study assessed the antiviral activity of pyridine-3-carbohydrazide (P-3-C) against CHIKV (strain La Reunion, LR) using Vero E6 and U-2OS cell lines.
analysis.methods: Vero E6 or U-2OS cells were infected with CHIKV and treated with P-3-C for 24 hours, after which cell viability and viral replication were measured to determine the 50% cytotoxic concentration (CC50), 50% effective concentration (EC50), and selective index (SI).
analysis.main_results: P-3-C reduced intracellular CHIKV RNA levels by 2 log10 compared with controls and decreased viral RNA release; in Vero E6 cells, the SI was greater than 48.8, while in U-2OS cells, the SI was 6.4.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret P-3-C’s antiviral effect as concentration-dependent and multitargeted, involving inhibition of nsP2 protease (IC50 = 12 μM ± 2) and binding to nsP4 polymerase (Kd = 54 μM ± 1), with molecular docking supporting interaction at catalytic pockets.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest P-3-C may be a candidate antiviral for CHIKV, particularly in cell lines where high selectivity is observed, warranting further evaluation in preclinical models.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s evidence strength is moderate due to reliance on in vitro models and variability in selectivity across cell lines, which limits generalizability to in vivo contexts.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated pyridine-3-carbohydrazide (P-3-C) as an antiviral against Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) using Vero E6 and U-2OS cell lines. Treatment with P-3-C for 24 hours significantly reduced intracellular CHIKV RNA by 2 log10 and decreased viral RNA release, with a selective index (SI) greater than 48.8 in Vero E6 cells and 6.4 in U-2OS cells. Mechanistic assays indicated P-3-C inhibits CHIKV nsP2 protease (IC50 = 12 μM ± 2) and binds nsP4 polymerase (Kd = 54 μM ± 1), with molecular docking supporting interaction at catalytic sites. The authors propose a multitarget mechanism of action. While promising, the study’s in vitro focus and cell-line-dependent efficacy limit direct clinical translation, warranting further investigation.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 等甲病毒正在全球范围内扩张,但仍然没有获得许可的 抗病毒药物 疗法,因此迫切需要有效的 抗病毒药物 药物。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用 Vero E6 和 U-2OS 细胞系评估了吡啶-3-碳酰肼 (P-3-C) 对 CHIKV(La Reunion 株,LR)的 抗病毒药物 活性。

title: Chikungunya fever among Japanese travelers: monthly and yearly trends in imported cases, 2011–2023
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Chikungunya poses an increasing threat to people living in endemic areas and to travelers from non-endemic regions. This study descriptively characterized imported chikungunya cases in Japan and explored the relationship between local incidence in destination areas and infection risk among Japanese travelers. METHODS: First, the descriptive features of imported chikungunya cases in Japan from 2011 to 2023 were examined. Second, monthly and yearly trends in the incidence of imported chikungunya cases among Japanese travelers were compared by destination with incidence in the corresponding destination country. Third, destination-specific incidence among Japanese travelers was compared between high- and low-transmission seasons in each destination country. RESULTS: Of 155 imported chikungunya cases in Japan during 2011-2023, 112 (72.3%) were associated with travel to Myanmar, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, or Thailand. The yearly chikungunya importation rate among Japanese travelers returning from Indonesia and Thailand was correlated with the corresponding rate among local residents. The monthly incidence of imported cases during the high-transmission season was 12.3, 7.4, 12.0, and 4.0 times higher than that during the low-transmission season among travelers returning from Myanmar, India, Indonesia, and the Philippines, respectively. CONCLUSION: The risk of imported chikungunya infection among Japanese travelers reflected the local epidemiology of chikungunya in destination countries, including both seasonal and long-term patterns. Imported-case data may support risk assessment in destination countries and contribute to traveler-specific prevention, improved diagnosis, and a reduced risk of autochthonous outbreaks.

analysis_zh.methods: 该研究考察了输入性基孔肯雅热病例的描述性特征,比较了日本旅行者中的 发病率 趋势与目的地国家当地的 发病率 趋势,并对比了目的地特定的 发病率 高季和低季之间的 发病率。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 日本旅行者中输入性基孔肯雅热感染的风险反映了目的地国家当地的流行病学,包括季节性和长期模式,表明旅行者风险与目的地层面的传播动态密切相关。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 导入的病例数据可以支持目的地国家的风险评估,并为旅行者特定的预防、改进的 诊断 以及降低本地 诊断 风险的措施提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其描述性设计和对被动 监测 数据的依赖而受到限制,这可能会低估真实病例数,并且缺乏详细的暴露或临床信息,需要对证据的强度进行谨慎解释。

title: Enhanced early IgG-mediated complement deposition in the development of chronic chikungunya virus disease
abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is an arthritogenic alphavirus that has spread globally and caused significant outbreaks. While CHIKV disease often resolves following acute infection, individuals can progress to chronic CHIKV disease (CCD) characterized by persistent severe joint pain. Antibodies, especially IgG, help clear CHIKV through neutralization and Fc effector functions. Previous studies have associated CCD with a poor neutralizing antibody response. However, the role of Fc effector functions in the development of CCD remains unclear. Here, purified IgG from post-acute CHIKV-immune human serum samples that either resolved CHIKV disease or developed chronic symptoms was evaluated for IgG neutralization, binding characteristics, and Fc effector functions to correlate antibody characteristics with disease progression and identify antibody biomarkers for CCD. Resolution of CHIKV disease was associated with higher levels of CHIKV-specific IgG and IgG1 and stronger CHIKV neutralization. Fc effector function analysis showed enhanced IgG-mediated complement deposition on infected cells in individuals who developed chronic disease; while, those who recovered had elevated complement components in their serum. Overall, these findings suggest that localized activation of the classical complement pathway at sites of infection, rather than systemic complement activity, may contribute to ongoing inflammation and immune dysregulation associated with CCD.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) causes acute febrile illness with potential progression to chronic joint disease, yet the immunological mechanisms driving chronic chikungunya disease (CCD) remain incompletely understood. The study addresses a knowledge gap regarding the role of Fc effector functions of IgG antibodies in CCD pathogenesis.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study evaluated purified IgG from post-acute CHIKV-immune human serum samples collected from individuals who either resolved CHIKV disease or developed chronic symptoms. The samples were analyzed to correlate antibody characteristics with disease outcomes.
analysis.methods: Purified IgG from human serum was assessed for CHIKV-specific IgG levels, IgG subclass distribution, neutralization capacity, and Fc effector functions including complement deposition on infected cells. Serum complement components were also measured.
analysis.main_results: Individuals who resolved CHIKV disease had higher levels of CHIKV-specific IgG and IgG1 and stronger neutralization compared to those who developed chronic disease. Enhanced IgG-mediated complement deposition on infected cells was observed in individuals with chronic disease, while recovered individuals showed elevated serum complement components.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that localized classical complement pathway activation at infection sites, rather than systemic complement activity, may drive ongoing inflammation and immune dysregulation in CCD. This highlights a previously underappreciated role of Fc-mediated complement deposition in disease chronicity.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study identifies potential antibody biomarkers for CCD risk stratification and suggests that targeting Fc effector functions or complement pathways could inform therapeutic strategies for preventing chronic chikungunya arthritis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its small sample size and lack of longitudinal sampling to establish causality between complement deposition and disease progression. The evidence is moderate due to the observational design and absence of mechanistic validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the role of IgG-mediated Fc effector functions in chronic chikungunya disease (CCD) pathogenesis by analyzing purified IgG from post-acute CHIKV-immune human serum samples. Individuals who resolved CHIKV disease exhibited higher CHIKV-specific IgG and IgG1 levels with stronger neutralization, whereas those who developed chronic disease showed enhanced IgG-mediated complement deposition on infected cells. The authors propose that localized complement activation at infection sites may contribute to ongoing inflammation in CCD. These findings suggest potential antibody biomarkers for CCD risk and therapeutic targets, though the study's small sample size and observational design limit causal inference.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 会引起急性发热性疾病,并可能进展为慢性关节疾病,但驱动慢性基孔肯雅病 (CCD) 的免疫机制仍不完全清楚。该研究解决了有关 CCD 发病机制 中 IgG 抗体 Fc 效应器功能作用的知识差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究评估了从已治愈 CHIKV 疾病或出现慢性症状的个体收集的急性 CHIKV 免疫后人血清样本中的纯化 IgG。对样本进行分析,将抗体特征与疾病结果联系起来。
elements_zh.methods: 评估从人血清中纯化的 IgG 的 CHIKV 特异性 IgG 水平、IgG 亚类分布、中和能力和 Fc 效应器功能,包括感染细胞上的补体沉积。还测量了血清补体成分。
elements_zh.main_results: 与患有慢性疾病的人相比,治愈 CHIKV 疾病的个体具有更高水平的 CHIKV 特异性 IgG 和 IgG1 以及更强的中和作用。在患有慢性疾病的个体中观察到受感染细胞上 IgG 介导的补体沉积增强,而康复个体则表现出血清补体成分升高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,感染部位的局部经典补体途径激活,而不是全身补体活性,可能会导致 CCD 中持续的炎症和免疫失调。这凸显了 Fc 介导的补体沉积在疾病慢性中的先前未被充分认识的作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究确定了用于 CCD 风险分层的潜在抗体生物标志物,并表明针对 Fc 效应器功能或补体途径可以为预防慢性基孔肯雅关节炎的治疗策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量小和缺乏纵向采样来确定补体沉积与疾病进展之间因果关系的限制。由于观察性设计和缺乏机制验证,证据是中等的。

abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 是一种致关节炎甲病毒,已在全球传播并造成严重的 暴发。虽然 CHIKV 疾病通常会在急性感染后消退,但个体也可能进展为慢性 CHIKV 疾病 (CCD),其特征是持续性严重关节疼痛。抗体,尤其是 IgG,通过中和和 Fc 效应子功能帮助清除 CHIKV。先前的研究表明 CCD 与中和抗体反应较差有关。然而,Fc 效应功能在 CCD 发育中的作用仍不清楚。在此,评估了从解决了 CHIKV 疾病或出现慢性症状的急性 CHIKV 免疫人血清样本中纯化的 IgG 的 IgG 中和、结合特征和 Fc 效应子功能,以将抗体特征与疾病进展相关联并鉴定 CCD 的抗体生物标志物。CHIKV 疾病的缓解与较高水平的 CHIKV 特异性 IgG 和 IgG1 以及更强的 CHIKV 中和有关。Fc效应子功能分析显示,在患有慢性疾病的个体中,IgG介导的补体沉积在受感染细胞上增强;而康复者血清中的补体成分升高。总体而言,这些发现表明,感染部位经典补体途径的局部激活,而不是全身补体活性,可能导致与 CCD 相关的持续炎症和免疫失调。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究评估了从已治愈 CHIKV 疾病或出现慢性症状的个体收集的急性 CHIKV 免疫后人血清样本中的纯化 IgG。对样本进行分析,将抗体特征与疾病结果联系起来。
analysis_zh.methods: 评估从人血清中纯化的 IgG 的 CHIKV 特异性 IgG 水平、IgG 亚类分布、中和能力和 Fc 效应器功能,包括感染细胞上的补体沉积。还测量了血清补体成分。
analysis_zh.main_results: 与患有慢性疾病的人相比,治愈 CHIKV 疾病的个体具有更高水平的 CHIKV 特异性 IgG 和 IgG1 以及更强的中和作用。在患有慢性疾病的个体中观察到受感染细胞上 IgG 介导的补体沉积增强,而康复个体则表现出血清补体成分升高。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,感染部位的局部经典补体途径激活,而不是全身补体活性,可能会导致 CCD 中持续的炎症和免疫失调。这凸显了 Fc 介导的补体沉积在疾病慢性中的先前未被充分认识的作用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究确定了用于 CCD 风险分层的潜在抗体生物标志物,并表明针对 Fc 效应器功能或补体途径可以为预防慢性基孔肯雅关节炎的治疗策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量小和缺乏纵向采样来确定补体沉积与疾病进展之间因果关系的限制。由于观察性设计和缺乏机制验证,证据是中等的。

title: Chikungunya Virus serological cross-reactivity in co-endemic settings: Mechanisms, Diagnostic implications, and epidemiological consequences
abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) causes an acute febrile illness with debilitating arthralgia, and serological assays remain central to its diagnosis and surveillance. However, antibody-based results are complicated by cross-reactivity in settings where multiple arboviruses co-circulate. This review distinguishes three related but distinct phenomena affecting CHIKV serology: biological cross-reactivity, arising from genuine antigenic overlap between related viruses; assay-associated non-target reactivity, in which a diagnostic platform generates a positive signal without an established biological relationship between the viruses; and diagnostic misclassification, the downstream epidemiological consequence of conflating the two. Applying this framework to five virus pairs, we find that CHIKV–O'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), CHIKV–Mayaro virus (MAYV) and CHIKV–Ross River virus (RRV) relationships are supported by shared alphavirus antigenic architecture and, in several studies, by functional cross-neutralisation. By contrast, CHIKV reactivity reported in dengue virus (DENV)- and Zika virus (ZIKV)-associated sera lacks an established biological basis and is better classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity of unresolved mechanism. These distinctions matter: unadjusted seropositivity can inflate or obscure CHIKV transmission estimates, and no single diagnostic platform resolves the problem for every virus pair. We argue that CHIKV diagnosis in co-endemic settings requires a layered strategy: molecular detection during the acute phase, antigenically informed and multiplex serology thereafter, and neutralisation-based confirmation where attribution is critical, combined with cross-reactivity-aware statistical modelling for surveillance. Strengthening assay validation and confirmatory testing, particularly in African settings such as Nigeria where CHIKV, DENV and related alphaviruses circulate together, is essential for improving diagnostic accuracy and epidemiological inference.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) serological cross-reactivity in co-endemic settings, focusing on diagnostic challenges and epidemiological consequences. The central question addresses how biological cross-reactivity, assay-associated non-target reactivity, and diagnostic misclassification affect CHIKV serological assays and surveillance accuracy.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This is a narrative review that distinguishes three phenomena affecting CHIKV serology: biological cross-reactivity, assay-associated non-target reactivity, and diagnostic misclassification. It applies this framework to CHIKV-related alphaviruses (O'nyong-nyong virus, Mayaro virus, Ross River virus) and unrelated flaviviruses (dengue virus, Zika virus). The review emphasizes the need for layered diagnostic strategies and assay validation in co-endemic regions like Nigeria.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: CHIKV shares antigenic overlap with related alphaviruses (ONNV, MAYV, RRV), supported by shared alphavirus architecture and functional cross-neutralisation. By contrast, CHIKV reactivity in DENV- and ZIKV-associated sera lacks a biological basis and is classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity. Unadjusted seropositivity can inflate or obscure CHIKV transmission estimates, and no single diagnostic platform resolves cross-reactivity for all virus pairs.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The mechanism underlying CHIKV reactivity in DENV- and ZIKV-associated sera remains unresolved and is better classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity. The review highlights that unadjusted seropositivity can distort CHIKV transmission estimates, but does not specify the extent of this distortion or provide quantitative evidence for its impact.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: A layered diagnostic strategy is recommended: molecular detection during the acute phase, antigenically informed and multiplex serology thereafter, and neutralisation-based confirmation where attribution is critical. Strengthening assay validation and confirmatory testing, particularly in African co-endemic settings like Nigeria, is essential for improving diagnostic accuracy and epidemiological inference.

analysis.summary_en: This review addresses Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) serological cross-reactivity in co-endemic settings, focusing on diagnostic challenges and epidemiological consequences. It distinguishes biological cross-reactivity (e.g., with ONNV, MAYV, RRV) from assay-associated non-target reactivity (e.g., with DENV, ZIKV) and highlights diagnostic misclassification as a key issue. The review concludes that CHIKV shares antigenic overlap with related alphaviruses, supported by functional cross-neutralisation, while reactivity in flavivirus-associated sera lacks a biological basis. It emphasizes that unadjusted seropositivity can distort transmission estimates and advocates for a layered diagnostic approach—molecular detection, multiplex serology, and neutralisation-based confirmation—combined with improved assay validation in co-endemic regions like Nigeria.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述检查了共流行环境中的 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 血清学交叉反应性,重点关注诊断挑战和流行病学后果。核心问题涉及生物交叉反应性、检测相关的非靶标反应性和诊断错误分类如何影响 CHIKV 血清学检测和 Z​​XQTERMHQXZ 准确性。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这是一篇叙述性综述,区分了影响 CHIKV 血清学 的三种现象:生物交叉反应性、检测相关的非目标反应性和诊断错误分类。它将这个框架应用于 CHIKV 相关的甲病毒(O'nyong-nyong 病毒、Mayaro 病毒、罗斯河病毒)和不相关的黄病毒(登革热病毒、寨卡病毒)。该审查强调在尼日利亚等共同流行地区需要分层诊断策略和检测验证。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: CHIKV 与相关甲病毒(ONNV、MAYV、RRV)具有抗原重叠,并得到共享甲病毒结构和功能交叉中和的支持。相比之下,DENV 和 ZIKV 相关血清中的 CHIKV 反应性缺乏生物学基础,被归类为与检测相关的非靶标反应性。未经调整的血清阳性率可能会夸大或掩盖 CHIKV 传播 估计值,并且没有一个诊断平台可以解决所有病毒对的交叉反应性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: DENV 和 ZIKV 相关血清中 CHIKV 反应性的机制仍未解决,最好归类为与检测相关的非靶标反应性。该审查强调,未经调整的血清阳性率可能会扭曲 CHIKV 传播 估计值,但没有具体说明这种扭曲的程度或提供其影响的定量证据。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 建议采用分层诊断策略:急性期进行分子检测,随后进行抗原告知和多重 血清学,以及基于中和的确认(其中归因至关重要)。加强分析验证和确认性检测,特别是在尼日利亚等非洲共流行地区,对于提高诊断准确性和流行病学推断至关重要。

abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 会导致急性发热性疾病,并导致 关节痛 衰弱,血清学检测仍然是 诊断 和 监测 的核心。然而,在多种虫媒病毒共同循环的环境中,基于抗体的结果因交叉反应而变得复杂。本综述区分了影响 CHIKV 血清学 的三种相关但不同的现象:生物交叉反应性,由相关病毒之间真正的抗原重叠引起;与检测相关的非目标反应性,其中诊断平台在病毒之间没有建立生物学关系的情况下产生阳性信号;诊断错误分类,将两者混为一谈的下游流行病学后果。将该框架应用于五个病毒对,我们发现CHIKV-O'nyong-nyong病毒(ONNV)、CHIKV-Mayaro病毒(MAYV)和CHIKV-罗斯河病毒(RRV)关系得到了共享的甲病毒抗原结构的支持,并且在一些研究中还得到了功能性交叉中和的支持。相比之下,登革热病毒 (DENV) 和寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 相关血清中报道的 CHIKV 反应性缺乏既定的生物学基础,最好归类为未解决机制的检测相关非靶标反应性。这些区别很重要:未经调整的血清阳性率可能会夸大或掩盖 CHIKV 传播 的估计值,并且没有一个诊断平台可以解决每个病毒对的问题。我们认为,共流行环境中的 CHIKV 诊断 需要分层策略:急性期进行分子检测,随后进行抗原告知和多重 血清学,以及基于中和的确认(其中归因至关重要),并结合 监测 的交叉反应感知统计模型。加强分析验证和确认性检测,特别是在尼日利亚等 CHIKV、DENV 和相关甲病毒共同传播的非洲地区,对于提高诊断准确性和流行病学推断至关重要。

title: A MATHEMATICAL MODEL OF CHIKUNGUNYA TRANSMISSION DYNAMICS: AN APPLICATION TO DATA FROM CHAD
abstract: Chikungunya is a vector-borne disease transmitted to humans by female Aedes mosquitoes, particularly Aedes albopictus. In this study, we develop a mathematical model to describe the transmission dynamics of chikungunya between humans and mosquito vectors, incorporating the effects of treatment interventions. We derive the basic reproduction number $\mathcal{R}_0$, which serves as a threshold parameter to characterize disease dynamics and establish the positivity and boundedness of solutions. Our analysis shows that the disease can be effectively controlled when $\mathcal{R}_0 < 1$. Parameter estimation is carried out using epidemiological data to inform strategies aimed at reducing secondary infections. Although no specific antiviral treatment currently exists, supportive care including the use of antibiotics for secondary infections is considered. We perform a detailed qualitative analysis of the model and conduct numerical simulations to assess the potential impact of treatment strategies and vector control measures. The results offer valuable insights into the conditions necessary for the control and possible eradication of chikungunya, particularly in the context of public health planning in affected regions such as Chad.

title: Autoantibodies neutralizing type I interferons underlie a third of cases of Chikungunya virus encephalitis or myelitis
abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection is typically not life threatening but may, in rare cases, affect the central nervous system (CNS). In three cohorts of confirmed CHIKV cases from Martinique (French overseas territory) and Brazil (patients aged 0 to 89 y, n = 245), 20 patients had CNS infection (aged 17 to 87 y). Autoantibodies neutralizing type I interferons (AAN-I-IFN) were found in 35% of patients (4 male and 3 female, aged 17 to 87 y) with encephalitis (4/15), encephalomyelitis (1/2), or myelitis (2/3), but were absent in 225 patients without CNS infection. They neutralized high concentrations (10 to 1,000 ng/mL) of IFN-α2, IFN-α8, and IFN-ω, and the antibodies of one patient also neutralized IFN-β. All samples also neutralized the other 10 IFN-α subtypes (at least 100 pg/mL). This combination of blood autoantibodies occurs in ~0.02% and 0.6% of healthy individuals under and over 70 y of age, respectively. The presence of AAN-I-IFN before CHIKV infection therefore increased the risk of CNS disease ~850-fold relative to the general population.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of autoantibodies neutralizing type I interferons in Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infections that lead to central nervous system (CNS) disease. title: Metagenomic sequencing detects viruses and bacteria in a cross-sectional clinical cohort of undifferentiated febrile illness in Nigeria.
abstract: UNLABELLED: Molecular and microscopy-based diagnostic capacity is often insufficient or unavailable in places where infectious disease burdens are highest, such as in West Africa. Rapid diagnostic testing (RDT) can provide quick and affordable diagnoses of common infections but is an imperfect solution due to limitations around detecting and dealing with false-negative and false-positive results. An alternative to RDT is unbiased metagenomic sequencing for pathogen surveillance. Here, we present data from unbiased metagenomic sequencing used to identify causes of undiagnosed febrile illness in Jos, Plateau State, Nigeria. Proof of concept for this approach has been demonstrated by several groups who have identified epidemic and endemic viral diseases like Lassa fever, yellow fever, and chikungunya. We show that unbiased deep sequencing and metagenomic analysis can be used to identify RNA viruses in clinical samples. We sequenced RNA from sera of patients (n = 343), many of whom were acutely febrile (76%), in a survey of clinics in Jos. We detected five human-infecting viruses in 39 (11 %) specimens. Among these were hepatitis B virus, human pegivirus, and several anelloviruses. While most of the viruses identified are unlikely to cause clinical symptoms in the patients we sampled, their presence demonstrates the validity of our approach. Additionally, our sequencing data allowed us to identify genetic material from potentially pathogenic bacteria, another possible etiological agent of febrile illness. IMPORTANCE: In low-resource areas, fevers due to infectious pathogens are a major source of illness, but tools for detecting and identifying such pathogens are often limited. Unbiased approaches for identifying genetic material from all potentially infectious organisms in a sample represent an opportunity for discovering sources of fever. Metagenomic sequencing can improve insight into pathogen landscapes in low-resource settings, potentially providing early detection of disease outbreaks. However, unbiased metagenomic sequencing (mNGS) is no panacea; it is susceptible to contamination and false positives. We used mNGS to evaluate serum from >300 Nigerian clinic-goers in Jos, Nigeria, most of whom (>70%) had fevers of unknown origin. Our goal was to understand arbovirus prevalence in Jos, Nigeria, and identify the sources of infection not routinely monitored for at clinics. We detected hepatitis B virus, as well as nonpathogenic anelloviruses. Our study provides insight into the utility and limitations of mNGS for pathogen surveillance.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated unbiased metagenomic sequencing (mNGS) as a diagnostic tool for identifying pathogens in 343 febrile patients in Jos, Nigeria, where diagnostic capacity is limited. Using RNA sequencing of sera, the authors detected five human-infecting viruses in 11% of samples, including hepatitis B virus, human pegivirus, and anelloviruses, while also identifying bacterial genetic material. The approach demonstrated proof of concept for pathogen surveillance but did not detect chikungunya virus or other arboviruses targeted in the study. The authors conclude that mNGS can enhance early outbreak detection and surveillance in low-resource settings, though susceptibility to contamination and false positives limits its reliability. The evidence supports moderate confidence in the utility of mNGS for pathogen discovery but not for specific arbovirus surveillance in this cohort.

title: Antibodies elicited by a chimeric peritrophin antigen reduce Aedes aegypti survival after blood feeding.
abstract: Vector-borne diseases transmitted by Aedes aegypti, including dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and yellow fever, represent a persistent and expanding global health threat. Limitations of conventional vector control strategies, such as insecticide use and environmental source reduction, particularly in urban settings, underscore the need for novel and complementary tools. Anti-vector vaccination offers one such strategy by inducing host-derived antibodies that are ingested during vector feeding and interfere with vector physiology or survival. Although this concept has been successfully explored in some hematophagous arthropods, it remains largely unexplored in mosquitoes. Here, we investigated mosquito peritrophins, structural components of the midgut peritrophic matrix, as potential targets for vector-directed vaccination. We designed and recombinantly expressed a chimeric antigen, PT-3, incorporating immunogenic regions from three Aedes aegypti peritrophins/peritrophin-like proteins: AAEL002495, AAEL002467, and AAEL004798. The ability of PT-3 to elicit functional antibodies was evaluated in a bovine host model. Immunization induced a robust antigen-specific humoral response, and mosquitoes fed blood supplemented with immune sera from vaccinated animals showed significantly reduced post-feeding survival compared with controls. Consistent with this functional effect, anti-PT-3 immune sera recognized native mosquito midgut components in ELISA and Western blot assays. Overall, results are consistent with antibody-mediated interference with midgut physiological processes during blood digestion, while no significant effects on oviposition or egg viability were observed among surviving females. Together, these findings provide proof-of-concept that mosquito peritrophins can serve as immunological targets for anti-vector vaccination and provide a rationale for further developing peritrophin-targeted strategies, including alternative delivery platforms, as complementary tools for arboviral control.

title: Effect of seasonal variation on the resting behavior of Aedes species (Diptera: Culicidae) in Metema district, Northwest, Ethiopia
abstract: Abstract Background: Aedes mosquitoes transmit several medically important viral diseases, including dengue fever, yellow fever, chikungunya, and Zika. These diseases have re-emerged as major global public health concerns due to increasing urbanization, rising temperatures associated with climate change, and intensified human mobility. Seasonal variation, particularly between the wet and dry seasons, influences the distribution and resting behavior of Aedes species in the Metema District of northwestern Ethiopia. Method: Adult Aedes mosquitoes were collected from both indoor and outdoor resting habitats, including grain storage facilities, deep ground grooves, cattle shelters, water-holding containers, and under bridges. Collections were conducted using pyrethrum spray catches (PSC), Prokopack aspirators, and mouth aspirators. Captured mosquitoes were identified to species level under a stereomicroscope using standard morphological identification keys. Data were entered and analyzed using IBM SPSS Statistics version 20.0. Results: A total of 4,054 adult Aedes mosquitoes were collected, comprising Aedes aegypti (3,026; 74.6%), Ae. vittatus (723; 17.8%), Ae. communis (186; 4.6%), Ae. albopictus (77; 1.9%), and Ae. Significantly higher numbers of Ae. vittatus were collected from cattle shelters than from other resting habitats ( P Ae. albopictus were primarily collected from larva-positive water containers, whereas Ae. opok was predominantly collected from beneath bridges. The abundance of adult Aedes mosquitoes peaked during the wet season (June–September 2023). In contrast, during the dry season (October–May), Aedes mosquitoes were mainly found resting in deep ground grooves and beneath bridges. A high proportion of blood-fed Aedes mosquitoes was collected from cattle shelters. The predominance of Ae. vittatus in cattle shelters during the wet season is likely associated with the availability of carbon dioxide, host body heat, and protection from adverse environmental conditions. During the dry season, the resting behavior of Aedes mosquitoes shifted toward moisture-retaining habitats, such as deep ground grooves and the undersides of bridges. Conclusions These findings highlight the importance of implementing targeted Aedes mosquito control strategies that account for seasonal variation and resting habitat preferences. Particular emphasis should be placed on managing key resting sites in urban areas, especially cattle shelters during the wet season and moisture-retaining refuges during the dry season. analysis.summary_en: This study investigated seasonal variation in the resting behavior of Aedes mosquitoes in the Metema District of northwestern Ethiopia, a region where Aedes-borne viral diseases such as chikungunya are of public health concern. Adult Aedes mosquitoes were collected from multiple indoor and outdoor resting habitats using standard entomological methods and identified morphologically. A total of 4,054 adult Aedes mosquitoes were collected, with Aedes aegypti being the most abundant species (74.6%), followed by Ae. vittatus (17.8%). Significantly higher numbers of Ae. vittatus were found in cattle shelters, particularly during the wet season, while other species showed distinct habitat preferences. The abundance of adult Aedes mosquitoes peaked during the wet season, whereas during the dry season, they were mainly found in moisture-retaining habitats such as deep ground grooves and beneath bridges. The authors highlight the importance of targeted vector control strategies that account for seasonal variation and resting habitat preferences, recommending strengthened entomological surveillance and seasonally adapted interventions to reduce the risk of Aedes-borne viral disease transmission.

title: Limited IgM seroreactivity to arboviruses in free-ranging black-tufted marmosets (Callithrix penicillata)
abstract: Arboviruses are important causes of human disease, and several species also infect wild animals that may serve as amplifying hosts. Among these, yellow fever virus ( Orthoflavivirus flavi ) is a major cause of morbidity and mortality in neotropical primates. In addition to yellow fever virus, several other arboviruses have been reported in these animals. For example, zika virus ( Orthoflavivirus zikaense ) has been detected in free-ranging marmosets and capuchin monkeys. Antibodies against dengue virus ( Orthoflavivirus denguei ) have been identified in Alouatta spp. and Ateles spp., while Sapajus spp., Ateles marginatus , and Callithrix jacchus have been shown to develop neutralizing antibodies against chikungunya virus ( Alphavirus chikungunya ). In this study we assessed anti-arboviruses ( A. zikaense , O.Denguei , and O. flavi ) antibodies in free-ranging black-tufted marmosets ( Callithrix penicillata ) living in urban parks. Frequency of putative seroreactivity was low with 2.94% (2/68) of the captured marmosets seroreactive to A. chikungunya (IgM) and 1.47% (1/68) seroreactive to O. One marmoset was seroreactive to both viruses ( A. Arboviruses genomic sequences were not detected in serum samples, but seroreactive animals were not tested by RT-PCR due to sample limitation. This study demonstrated limited evidence of putative seroreactivity of free-ranging black-tufted marmosets to arboviruses in an area where these viruses are endemic in the human population.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in urban parks where free-ranging black-tufted marmosets (Callithrix penicillata) reside. analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the seroreactivity of free-ranging black-tufted marmosets to arboviruses, particularly chikungunya virus, in an urban area where these viruses are endemic in humans. Results showed low seroreactivity rates, with 2.94% of marmosets reactive to chikungunya virus (IgM) and 1.47% to dengue virus. One marmoset was found to be seroreactive to both viruses. However, the findings are limited by the small sample size and lack of RT-PCR testing for seroreactive individuals, resulting in moderate confidence in the conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究旨在评估自由放养的黑簇绒狨猴对虫媒病毒的血清反应性,特别是在这些病毒在人类中流行的地区。虫媒病毒是人类疾病的重要原因,一些物种也感染野生动物,这些动物可能起到放大 宿主 的作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究是在城市公园进行的,那里栖息着自由放养的黑簇绒狨猴(Callithrix penicillata)。在这些病毒在人群中流行的地区,总共捕获了 68 只狨猴并测试了其对虫媒病毒(包括 基孔肯雅病毒)的血清反应性。
elements_zh.methods: 使用抗体检测方法评估对虫媒病毒的血清反应性。血清样本中未检测到虫媒病毒基因组序列,但由于样本限制,未对血清反应性动物进行 RT-PCR 检测。
elements_zh.main_results: 假定的血清反应频率较低,捕获的狨猴中有 2.94% (2/68) 对 基孔肯雅病毒 (IgM) 有血清反应,对登革热病毒有 1.47% (1/68) 血清反应。一只狨猴对这两种病毒均呈血清反应。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究证明,自由放养的黑簇绒狨猴对虫媒病毒具有血清反应性的证据有限,强调需要进一步研究这些动物在虫媒病毒 传播 中的作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,自由放养的黑簇绒狨猴可能不会显着放大 宿主 的 基孔肯雅病毒,这对于了解城市环境中虫媒病毒的生态和 传播 动态具有重要意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究样本量有限,由于样本限制,没有通过RT-PCR测试血清反应动物,这可能会影响证据的强度。由于这些限制,研究结果的可信度较低。

title: Indirect Immunofluorescence (IFA) for Viral Antigen Detection v1
abstract: A protocol for indirect immunofluorescence assay (IFA) to detect viral antigens in infected cell monolayers or tissue sections using virus-specific primary antibodies and fluorochrome-conjugated secondary antibodies. Covers cell infection, fixation, permeabilization, antibody staining, and fluorescence microscopy imaging. Protocol developed by abinScience / AtaGenix Technical Team. Indirect immunofluorescence (IFA) is a standard method for confirming viral infection, determining viral tropism, and evaluating antiviral interventions in cell culture. The assay uses a virus-specific primary antibody to bind intracellular or surface viral antigens, followed by a fluorochrome-conjugated secondary antibody for visualization. This protocol is optimized for common veterinary and human pathogen targets including PEDV (porcine epidemic diarrhea virus), SFTSV (severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus), CHIKV (chikungunya virus), ASFV (African swine fever virus), and other enveloped and non-enveloped viruses. It is applicable to both adherent and suspension cell lines.

title: Etiological Spectrum of Acute Febrile Illness in a Tertiary Care Hospital in Assam, India: A Cross-Sectional Study
abstract: Introduction: Acute Febrile Illness (AFI) encompasses a spectrum of conditions marked by fever, often caused by various infectious agents. The aetiological diversity poses challenges in diagnosis and treatment, particularly in regions with limited diagnostic resources. Aim: To evaluate the spectrum of pathogens causing AFI with or without rash in patients. Materials and Methods: A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted from January 2024 to December 2024 on 1,544 patients who had attended Lakhimpur Medical College and Hospital, North Lakhimpur, Assam, India. Patients with fever (≥ 37.5°C) with or without rash were enrolled. Serological investigations for Measles, Rubella, Dengue, Varicella-zoster, Chikungunya viruses, Japanese Encephalitis (JE), Orientia tsutsugamushi, Leptospira, and Hepatitis viruses were performed using Enzyme-linked Immunosorbent assay (ELISA) and Rapid Detection Testing (RDT) kits. Data analysis was performed using both descriptive and inferential methods. A p-value of <0.05 was considered significant. Results: Fever was prevalent in all 1,544 (100%) cases, followed by 856 (55.44%) cases of headache, 636 (41.19%) with cough, 476 (30.83%) with vomiting, 347 (22.47%) with abdominal pain, 59 (3.82%) cases with dysentery, 52 (3.37%) with diarrhoea, 46 (2.98%) cases with unconsciousness, and 21 (1.36%) cases presented with rash. Fever was observed in combination with headache in 856 (55.44%), with cough in 636 (41.19%), with bodyache in 481 (31.15%), and with vomiting in 476 (30.83%) cases. The study identified seasonal variations in infection rates, with peaks during the monsoon months. The majority of positive cases were attributed to Scrub Typhus 133/817 (16.28%), followed by Leptospirosis 129/473 (27.27%), Dengue 84/1273 (6.59%), and JE 20/87 (22.99%), while some had co-infection. Conclusion: The study underscores the importance of integrated clinical and laboratory approaches in diagnosing AFI. Scrub typhus, leptospirosis, and dengue were identified as major causes, emphasising the need for enhanced surveillance and diagnostic capabilities.

title_zh: 印度阿萨姆邦一家三级护理医院急性发热性疾病的病因学谱:一项横断面研究
source_body_en: Introduction: Acute Febrile Illness (AFI) encompasses a spectrum of conditions marked by fever, often caused by various infectious agents. The aetiological diversity poses challenges in diagnosis and treatment, particularly in regions with limited diagnostic resources. Aim: To evaluate the spectrum of pathogens causing AFI with or without rash in patients. Materials and Methods: A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted from January 2024 to December 2024 on 1,544 patients who had attended Lakhimpur Medical College and Hospital, North Lakhimpur, Assam, India. Patients with fever (≥ 37.5°C) with or without rash were enrolled. Serological investigations for Measles, Rubella, Dengue, Varicella-zoster, Chikungunya viruses, Japanese Encephalitis (JE), Orientia tsutsugamushi, Leptospira, and Hepatitis viruses were performed using Enzyme-linked Immunosorbent assay (ELISA) and Rapid Detection Testing (RDT) kits. Data analysis was performed using both descriptive and inferential methods. A p-value of <0.05 was considered significant. Results: Fever was prevalent in all 1,544 (100%) cases, followed by 856 (55.44%) cases of headache, 636 (41.19%) with cough, 476 (30.83%) with vomiting, 347 (22.47%) with abdominal pain, 59 (3.82%) cases with dysentery, 52 (3.37%) with diarrhoea, 46 (2.98%) cases with unconsciousness, and 21 (1.36%) cases presented with rash. Fever was observed in combination with headache in 856 (55.44%), with cough in 636 (41.19%), with bodyache in 481 (31.15%), and with vomiting in 476 (30.83%) cases. The study identified seasonal variations in infection rates, with peaks during the monsoon months. The majority of positive cases were attributed to Scrub Typhus 133/817 (16.28%), followed by Leptospirosis 129/473 (27.27%), Dengue 84/1273 (6.59%), and JE 20/87 (22.99%), while some had co-infection. Conclusion: The study underscores the importance of integrated clinical and laboratory approaches in diagnosing AFI. Scrub typhus, leptospirosis, and dengue were identified as major causes, emphasising the need for enhanced surveillance and diagnostic capabilities.
abstract_zh: 简介:急性发热性疾病 (AFI) 涵盖一系列以发烧为特征的病症,通常由各种传染源引起。病因多样性给 诊断 和 治疗 带来了挑战,特别是在诊断资源有限的地区。目的:评估引起 AFI(伴或不伴皮疹)患者的病原体谱。材料和方法:2024 年 1 月至 2024 年 12 月,对印度阿萨姆邦北拉金布尔拉金布尔医学院和医院就诊的 1,544 名患者进行了一项以医院为基础的横断面研究。发热(≥ 37.5°C)伴或不伴皮疹的患者纳入研究。使用酶联免疫吸附测定 (ELISA) 和快速检测测试 (RDT) 试剂盒对麻疹、风疹、登革热、水痘带状疱疹、基孔肯雅病毒、日本脑炎 (JE)、恙虫病东方体、钩端螺旋体和肝炎病毒进行血清学研究。使用描述性和推理性方法进行数据分析。p 值 <0.05 被认为是显着的。结果:1544例(100%)患者中,以发热为主,其次为头痛856例(55.44%),咳嗽636例(41.19%),呕吐476例(30.83%),腹痛347例(22.47%),腹泻59例(3.82%),腹泻52例(3.37%)。腹泻,意识不清 46 例(2.98%),皮疹 21 例(1.36%)。发热伴头痛856例(55.44%),伴咳嗽636例(41.19%),伴全身疼痛481例(31.15%),伴呕吐476例(30.83%)。该研究确定了感染率的季节性变化,在季风月份达到峰值。大多数阳性病例归因于恙虫病133/817(16.28%),其次是钩端螺旋体病129/473(27.27%),登革热84/1273(6.59%)和乙型脑炎20/87(22.99%),还有一些合并感染。结论:该研究强调了综合临床和实验室方法在诊断 AFI 中的重要性。恙虫病、钩端螺旋体病和登革热被确定为主要原因,强调需要增强 监测 和诊断能力。

title: OVERVIEW OF THE MOST FREQUENTLY OCCURRING NOTIFIABLE INFECTIOUS DISEASES IN AMAZONAS BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
abstract: Introduction: Compulsory notification is the mandatory reporting of suspected or confirmed diseases, health conditions, or public health events by healthcare professionals and services to health authorities. Objective: To describe the epidemiological profile of major infectious diseases (endemic diseases, arboviruses, respiratory viral infections, and emerging or re-emerging notifiable diseases) in Amazonas. Methodology: This is a retrospective descriptive study using a quantitative approach to public data to present descriptive statistics and temporal trends. Only data obtained directly from epidemiological bulletins published on the website of the Amazonas Health Surveillance Foundation (FVS-RCP) for the years 2021 to 2025 were included. Results: During this period, 391,189 cases of infections considered most recurrent in Amazonas were reported. The majority of cases (332,019; 84.9%) involved infectious diseases of major epidemiological importance, including endemic conditions: malaria, tuberculosis, leishmaniasis, leprosy, viral hepatitis, and syphilis in infants under one year of age. Regarding dengue—considered the most frequent arbovirus in the state—there were 31,402 (8.03%) cases during the period. For Chikungunya, Zika, Oropouche, and Mayaro—arboviruses requiring immediate notification but occurring less frequently—there were 1,336 (0.3%) cases. A significant number of respiratory infections caused by Influenza viruses and COVID-19 (16,874; 4.3%) were also recorded. Significant fluctuations and spikes in the incidence of these infectious diseases were observed in Amazonas between 2021 and 2025. Conclusion: The situation in Amazonas is concerning due to geographic, environmental, and climatic factors, as well as urban expansion.

title_original: OVERVIEW OF THE MOST FREQUENTLY OCCURRING NOTIFIABLE INFECTIOUS DISEASES IN AMAZONAS BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the public-health need to characterize the burden and trends of notifiable infectious diseases in Amazonas, where geographic, environmental, and climatic factors may influence transmission. It asks for an epidemiological profile of major diseases, including arboviruses such as chikungunya, to inform surveillance and control priorities.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective descriptive study with a quantitative approach was conducted using publicly available epidemiological bulletins from the Amazonas Health Surveillance Foundation (FVS-RCP) covering 2021 to 2025. Only data reported in these bulletins were included.
analysis.methods: The study applied a retrospective descriptive design with quantitative analysis of public surveillance data. Descriptive statistics and temporal trends were generated from the bulletins, but no laboratory assays, sequencing, or interventional protocols were described.
analysis.main_results: Between 2021 and 2025, 391,189 cases of the most recurrent notifiable infections were reported in Amazonas, with 332,019 (84.9%) involving major endemic diseases and 31,402 (8.03%) cases of dengue. Chikungunya accounted for 1,336 (0.3%) cases, alongside smaller numbers for Zika, Oropouche, and Mayaro.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the fluctuations and spikes in incidence as driven by Amazonas’s geographic, environmental, and climatic conditions, coupled with urban expansion. The novelty lies in the integrated temporal description of multiple notifiable diseases, highlighting arbovirus co-circulation and burden.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the need for strengthened surveillance and targeted control measures for arboviruses like chikungunya in Amazonas, particularly given their co-circulation and the state’s ecological vulnerabilities.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited by its reliance on passive surveillance data, which may underestimate true incidence and lacks laboratory confirmation or detailed clinical characterization. The strength of evidence is therefore low to moderate for drawing causal or precise epidemiological inferences.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective descriptive study analyzed compulsory notification data from Amazonas Health Surveillance Foundation bulletins (2021–2025) to profile major notifiable infectious diseases, including arboviruses. Among 391,189 reported cases, chikungunya accounted for 1,336 (0.3%) cases, with dengue (8.03%) and other arboviruses (Zika, Oropouche, Mayaro) also present. The authors attribute observed fluctuations to environmental, climatic, and urban factors. While the study provides a broad epidemiological overview, its reliance on passive surveillance data and lack of laboratory confirmation limit the precision and strength of conclusions regarding chikungunya specifically.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究满足了公共卫生需求,以描述亚马逊地区法定传染病的负担和趋势,其中地理、环境和气候因素可能会影响 传播。它要求提供主要疾病的流行病学概况,包括基孔肯雅热等虫媒病毒,以便为 监测 和控制优先事项提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用亚马逊健康 监测 基金会 (FVS-RCP) 公开的 2021 年至 2025 年流行病学公报进行了一项采用定量方法的回顾性描述性研究。仅包含这些公报中报告的数据。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用回顾性描述性设计,对公共 监测 数据进行定量分析。公告中生成了描述性统计数据和时间趋势,但没有描述实验室分析、测序或介入方案。
elements_zh.main_results: 2021年至2025年间,亚马逊州报告了391,189例最频繁的法定感染病例,其中332,019例(84.9%)涉及主要地方病,31,402例(8.03%)涉及登革热病例。基孔肯雅热病例占 1,336 例(0.3%),此外还有数量较少的寨卡病毒、奥罗普切病毒和马亚罗病毒。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将 发病率 的波动和峰值解释为亚马逊地理、环境和气候条件以及城市扩张造成的。新颖之处在于对多种法定疾病的综合时间描述,突出了虫媒病毒的共循环和负担。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要加强 监测 和针对亚马逊地区基孔肯雅热等虫媒病毒采取有针对性的控制措施,特别是考虑到它们的共同循环和该州的生态脆弱性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据因其对被动 发病率 数据的依赖而受到限制,这可能低估了真实的 发病率 并且缺乏实验室确认或详细的临床特征。因此,对于得出因果或精确的流行病学推论而言,证据的强度为低至中等。

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A retrospective descriptive study with a quantitative approach was conducted using publicly available epidemiological bulletins from the Amazonas Health Surveillance Foundation (FVS-RCP) covering 2021 to 2025. Only data reported in these bulletins were included.
analysis_en.methods: The study applied a retrospective descriptive design with quantitative analysis of public surveillance data. Descriptive statistics and temporal trends were generated from the bulletins, but no laboratory assays, sequencing, or interventional protocols were described.
analysis_en.main_results: Between 2021 and 2025, 391,189 cases of the most recurrent notifiable infections were reported in Amazonas, with 332,019 (84.9%) involving major endemic diseases and 31,402 (8.03%) cases of dengue. Chikungunya accounted for 1,336 (0.3%) cases, alongside smaller numbers for Zika, Oropouche, and Mayaro.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the fluctuations and spikes in incidence as driven by Amazonas’s geographic, environmental, and climatic conditions, coupled with urban expansion. The novelty lies in the integrated temporal description of multiple notifiable diseases, highlighting arbovirus co-circulation and burden.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the need for strengthened surveillance and targeted control measures for arboviruses like chikungunya in Amazonas, particularly given their co-circulation and the state’s ecological vulnerabilities.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited by its reliance on passive surveillance data, which may underestimate true incidence and lacks laboratory confirmation or detailed clinical characterization. The strength of evidence is therefore low to moderate for drawing causal or precise epidemiological inferences.

title_zh: 2021 年至 2025 年亚马逊最常发生的值得注意的传染病概述
source_body_en: Introduction: Compulsory notification is the mandatory reporting of suspected or confirmed diseases, health conditions, or public health events by healthcare professionals and services to health authorities. Objective: To describe the epidemiological profile of major infectious diseases (endemic diseases, arboviruses, respiratory viral infections, and emerging or re-emerging notifiable diseases) in Amazonas. Methodology: This is a retrospective descriptive study using a quantitative approach to public data to present descriptive statistics and temporal trends. Only data obtained directly from epidemiological bulletins published on the website of the Amazonas Health Surveillance Foundation (FVS-RCP) for the years 2021 to 2025 were included. Results: During this period, 391,189 cases of infections considered most recurrent in Amazonas were reported. The majority of cases (332,019; 84.9%) involved infectious diseases of major epidemiological importance, including endemic conditions: malaria, tuberculosis, leishmaniasis, leprosy, viral hepatitis, and syphilis in infants under one year of age. Regarding dengue—considered the most frequent arbovirus in the state—there were 31,402 (8.03%) cases during the period. For Chikungunya, Zika, Oropouche, and Mayaro—arboviruses requiring immediate notification but occurring less frequently—there were 1,336 (0.3%) cases. A significant number of respiratory infections caused by Influenza viruses and COVID-19 (16,874; 4.3%) were also recorded. Significant fluctuations and spikes in the incidence of these infectious diseases were observed in Amazonas between 2021 and 2025. Conclusion: The situation in Amazonas is concerning due to geographic, environmental, and climatic factors, as well as urban expansion.
abstract_zh: 简介:强制通报是指医疗保健专业人员和服务机构向卫生当局强制报告疑似或确诊疾病、健康状况或公共卫生事件。目的:描述亚马逊地区主要传染病(地方病、虫媒病毒、呼吸道病毒感染以及新出现或重新出现的法定传染病)的流行病学概况。方法:这是一项回顾性描述性研究,使用公共数据的定量方法来呈现描述性统计数据和时间趋势。仅包括直接从亚马逊健康 监测 基金会 (FVS-RCP) 网站上发布的 2021 年至 2025 年流行病学公报中获得的数据。结果:在此期间,亚马逊州报告了 391,189 例被认为是最常复发的感染病例。大多数病例(332,019;84.9%)涉及具有重要流行病学意义的传染病,包括地方病:疟疾、结核病、利什曼病、麻风病、病毒性肝炎和一岁以下婴儿梅毒。登革热被认为是该州最常见的虫媒病毒,在此期间有 31,402 例(8.03%)病例。对于基孔肯雅热、寨卡病毒、奥罗普切病毒和马亚罗病毒(需要立即通知但发生频率较低的虫媒病毒),共有 1,336 例(0.3%)病例。还记录了大量由流感病毒和 COVID-19 引起的呼吸道感染(16,874 例;4.3%)。2021 年至 2025 年间,亚马逊地区这些传染病的 发病率 出现了显着波动和高峰。结论:由于地理、环境和气候因素以及城市扩张,亚马逊地区的情况令人担忧。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究满足了公共卫生需求,以描述亚马逊地区法定传染病的负担和趋势,其中地理、环境和气候因素可能会影响 传播。它要求提供主要疾病的流行病学概况,包括基孔肯雅热等虫媒病毒,以便为 监测 和控制优先事项提供信息。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用亚马逊健康 监测 基金会 (FVS-RCP) 公开的 2021 年至 2025 年流行病学公报进行了一项采用定量方法的回顾性描述性研究。仅包含这些公报中报告的数据。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究采用回顾性描述性设计,对公共 监测 数据进行定量分析。公告中生成了描述性统计数据和时间趋势,但没有描述实验室分析、测序或介入方案。
analysis_zh.main_results: 2021年至2025年间,亚马逊州报告了391,189例最频繁的法定感染病例,其中332,019例(84.9%)涉及主要地方病,31,402例(8.03%)涉及登革热病例。基孔肯雅热病例占 1,336 例(0.3%),此外还有数量较少的寨卡病毒、奥罗普切病毒和马亚罗病毒。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将 发病率 的波动和峰值解释为亚马逊地理、环境和气候条件以及城市扩张造成的。新颖之处在于对多种法定疾病的综合时间描述,突出了虫媒病毒的共循环和负担。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要加强 监测 和针对亚马逊地区基孔肯雅热等虫媒病毒采取有针对性的控制措施,特别是考虑到它们的共同循环和该州的生态脆弱性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据因其对被动 发病率 数据的依赖而受到限制,这可能低估了真实的 发病率 并且缺乏实验室确认或详细的临床特征。因此,对于得出因果或精确的流行病学推论而言,证据的强度为低至中等。

title: Evidence of co-circulation and co-exposure to arboviruses and malaria in a longitudinal cohort in Kenya from 2019 to 2022
abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), dengue virus (DENV), and malaria have gained significant concern in sub-Saharan Africa. The similar epidemiology, endemicity and clinical presentation of the diseases caused by these pathogens underscore the need to investigate the burden and emergence of mixed infections and the potential factors that increase the risk of coexistence and co-circulation of these pathogens. In this study, we determine the burden of co-exposure and co-infection of CHIKV, DENV, and malaria in Kenya and describe the associated risk factors. We followed 4,534 study participants from December 2019 to February 2022 on the coast (Ukunda) and west (Kisumu) of Kenya to quantify the burden of CHIKV, DENV, and malaria co-infections and recent and lifetime co-exposure. The results highlight 15.5% acute malarial infection, 0.7% acute DENV infection, and 0.06% acute CHIKV infection in our cohort. No acute co-infection was detected. The lifetime co-exposure to DENV and malaria was 0.75% and CHIKV and malaria was 1.8%. We estimated ~ 0.2% of the study population to be co-exposed to DENV, CHIKV, and malaria. The study highlights the importance of higher socioeconomic status, mosquito prevention methods, and sleeping under the bed nets to decrease the co-exposure to DENV, CHIKV, and malaria and, crowding and presence of water containers to increase the co-exposure to DENV, CHIKV, and malaria.

title_original: Evidence of co-circulation and co-exposure to arboviruses and malaria in a longitudinal cohort in Kenya from 2019 to 2022

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the growing public-health concern posed by chikungunya virus (CHIKV), dengue virus (DENV), and malaria in sub-Saharan Africa, where similar clinical presentations complicate diagnosis and control. It asks whether these pathogens co-circulate and co-expose individuals, and what risk factors drive their coexistence.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A longitudinal cohort study followed 4,534 participants from December 2019 to February 2022 in two Kenyan sites: Ukunda on the coast and Kisumu in the west. The design aimed to quantify the burden of co-infections and co-exposures to CHIKV, DENV, and malaria.
analysis.methods: The study measured acute infections and lifetime co-exposure to CHIKV, DENV, and malaria using serological and parasitological assays in a defined cohort over a 27-month period.
analysis.main_results: Acute malarial infection was detected in 15.5% of participants, acute DENV in 0.7%, and acute CHIKV in 0.06%. No acute co-infections were detected, while lifetime co-exposure to DENV and malaria was 0.75%, to CHIKV and malaria was 1.8%, and to all three pathogens was estimated at ~0.2%.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the low prevalence of acute CHIKV and the absence of acute co-infections as evidence of limited immediate clinical overlap, while highlighting measurable lifetime co-exposure that may inform future surveillance strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that socioeconomic factors, mosquito prevention, and bed-net use may reduce co-exposure risk, whereas crowding and water containers may increase it, guiding targeted interventions in endemic regions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s abstract-only evidence and lack of detailed methods or statistical power assessments limit the strength of conclusions; further data are needed to confirm risk factors and generalisability.

analysis.summary_en: This longitudinal cohort study in Kenya quantified the burden of co-exposure and co-infection to chikungunya virus (CHIKV), dengue virus (DENV), and malaria among 4,534 participants from December 2019 to February 2022. Acute infections were detected in 15.5% for malaria, 0.7% for DENV, and 0.06% for CHIKV, with no acute co-infections observed. Lifetime co-exposure was 0.75% for DENV and malaria, 1.8% for CHIKV and malaria, and ~0.2% for all three pathogens. The authors link higher socioeconomic status, mosquito prevention, and bed-net use to reduced co-exposure risk, while crowding and water containers may increase it. However, the abstract-only evidence and absence of detailed methods limit the strength of these conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了撒哈拉以南非洲地区 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV)、登革热病毒 (DENV) 和疟疾引起的日益严重的公共卫生问题,这些地区类似的临床表现使 诊断 和控制变得复杂。它询问这些病原体是否共同循环并共同暴露于个体,以及哪些风险因素驱动它们共存。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项纵向 队列研究 研究从 2019 年 12 月至 2022 年 2 月对肯尼亚两个地点的 4,534 名参与者进行了跟踪:海岸的乌昆达和西部的基苏木。该设计旨在量化 CHIKV、DENV 和疟疾的双重感染和共同暴露的负担。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究在 27 个月的时间里,在规定的 队列研究 中使用血清学和寄生虫学检测方法,测量了急性感染和终生同时接触 CHIKV、DENV 和疟疾的情况。
elements_zh.main_results: 在参与者中,检测到15.5%为急性疟疾感染,0.7%为急性登革病毒(DENV)感染,0.06%为急性基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)感染。未检测到急性共感染;终生共暴露于登革病毒与疟疾为0.75%,基孔肯雅病毒与疟疾为1.8%,三种病原体共暴露的估计值约为0.2%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将急性 CHIKV 的低 患病率 和不存在急性合并感染解释为有限的直接临床重叠的证据,同时强调可测量的终生共同暴露,这可能为未来的 监测 策略提供信息。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,社会经济因素、蚊虫预防和使用蚊帐可能会降低共同暴露风险,而拥挤和水容器可能会增加共同暴露风险,从而指导流行地区采取有针对性的干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅提供抽象证据,缺乏详细方法或统计功效评估,限制了结论的力度;需要进一步的数据来确认风险因素和普遍性。

The results highlight 15.5% acute malarial infection, 0.7% acute DENV infection, and 0.06% acute CHIKV infection in our cohort. No acute co-infection was detected. The lifetime co-exposure to DENV and malaria was 0.75% and CHIKV and malaria was 1.8%. We estimated ~ 0.2% of the study population to be co-exposed to DENV, CHIKV, and malaria. The study highlights the importance of higher socioeconomic status, mosquito prevention methods, and sleeping under the bed nets to decrease the co-exposure to DENV, CHIKV, and malaria and, crowding and presence of water containers to increase the co-exposure to DENV, CHIKV, and malaria.

title: RNA Cis-Elements Involved in Animal Virus Stop Codon Readthrough: Stop Codon Context and Downstream RNA Structures
abstract: Stop codon readthrough is a noncanonical translation strategy employed by certain RNA viruses, in which a viral termination codon is either decoded by host near-cognate tRNAs or canonically recognized by the class I release factor (RF, eRF1 in eukaryotes). Ribosomal A-site competition between near-cognate tRNAs and eRF can shift decoding toward near-cognate tRNAs, thereby promoting non-canonical decoding events by transiently pausing termination and favoring readthrough. This review focuses on two viral cis-elements that modulate readthrough across four viral genera in which this decoding event has been experimentally validated: (i) primary sequences surrounding the stop codon (stop codon context), and (ii) downstream RNA structures. Effects of stop codon context have been observed more broadly in cellular genes, including nonsense suppression in bacteria, with mechanisms including inefficient RF association or tRNA interactions at adjacent sense codons. In eukaryotic systems, interactions with the ribosomal mRNA entry channel have been suggested. Diverse downstream structures, including gammaretroviral pseudoknots and specific structures in alpha- and coltiviruses, further stimulate readthrough in a location- and structure-sensitive manner. This effect has not been consistently observed in chikungunya and triatoviral structures, suggesting a strong dependence on local sequence and structural context. Compared with the larger number of cellular readthrough occurrences that can be detected at low efficiency by ribosome profiling, viral readthrough in mammalian systems is consistently high (>2%). Understanding the interplay between viral RNA elements and host translational machinery, including potential kinetic trapping at the termination codon, provides insights into this unusual elongation mechanism. These findings may have implications for antiviral strategies targeting these RNA elements.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the mechanisms of stop codon readthrough in Chikungunya virus, focusing on cis-elements that modulate this process. It highlights the role of stop codon context and downstream RNA structures in promoting readthrough, which is a noncanonical translation strategy. The review notes that while stop codon readthrough is common in cellular genes, its occurrence in viral systems, particularly in Chikungunya virus, is more consistent and significant. It also discusses the potential implications of these findings for antiviral strategies. However, the effect of stop codon context on readthrough is not consistently observed in all viral genera, indicating a strong dependence on local sequence and structural context. The review emphasizes the importance of understanding the interaction between viral RNA elements and host translational machinery to develop targeted interventions.

abstract_zh: 终止密码子通读是某些 RNA 病毒采用的非规范翻译策略,其中病毒终止密码子要么由 宿主 近同源 tRNA 解码,要么由 I 类释放因子(真核生物中的 RF、eRF1)规范识别。近同源 tRNA 和 eRF 之间的核糖体 A 位点竞争可以将解码转向近同源 tRNA,从而通过短暂暂停终止和有利于通读来促进非规范解码事件。本综述重点关注两个病毒顺式元件,它们调节四个病毒属的通读,其中该解码事件已通过实验验证:(i) 终止密码子周围的一级序列(终止密码子上下文),以及 (ii) 下游 RNA 结构。终止密码子环境的影响在细胞基因中得到了更广泛的观察,包括细菌中的无义抑制,其机制包括低效的 RF 关联或相邻有义密码子处的 tRNA 相互作用。在真核系统中,已提出与核糖体 mRNA 进入通道的相互作用。不同的下游结构,包括γ逆转录病毒假结以及α病毒和大肠杆菌病毒中的特定结构,以位置和结构敏感的方式进一步刺激通读。在基孔肯雅热和三核病毒结构中尚未一致地观察到这种效应,表明对局部序列和结构背景的强烈依赖性。与通过核糖体分析以低效率检测到的大量细胞通读发生相比,哺乳动物系统中的病毒通读始终很高(>2%)。了解病毒 RNA 元件和 宿主 翻译机制之间的相互作用,包括终止密码子处的潜在动力学捕获,可以深入了解这种不寻常的延伸机制。这些发现可能对针对这些 RNA 元件的 抗病毒药物 策略产生影响。

title: Estimación del riesgo a la salud por exposición laboral a pesticidas utilizados en el control de vectores en México
abstract: El uso de pesticidas en México se ha promovido ampliamente para el control y combate de vectores que transmiten enfermedades víricas como chikungunya, dengue, paludismo y zika, que actualmente constituyen un problema de salud pública en el país, siendo el sector laboral dedicado a la aplicación de estos productos la población más expuesta. En el presente estudio se estimó el riesgo para la salud por exposición ocupacional a los principales pesticidas utilizados para el control de vectores de enfermedades, recomendados por el Centro Nacional de Programas Preventivos y Control de Enfermedades (CENAPRECE) y potencialmente tóxicos para los seres humanos (bifentrina, pirimifos-metil y bendiocarb). Para ello, se identificaron sus posibles efectos sobre la salud considerando su potencial tóxico (pT) y neurotóxico (pNe), así como la dosis de exposición estimada (DEE) en el ámbito laboral, de acuerdo con los años de exposición. Se determinaron el riesgo no cancerígeno individual (HQi) y el índice de riesgo (HI). Se encontró que el bendiocarb presentó los valores más altos de riesgo de efectos no cancerígenos sobre la salud (HQ > 1 = riesgo alto), con incrementos significativos de 1.35, 2.7 y 4.1 conforme aumentaron los años de exposición laboral (5, 10 y 15 años, respectivamente). Por su parte, la bifentrina y el pirimifos metil mostraron incrementos proporcionales al tiempo de exposición laboral, pero con valores de HQ < 1 (bajo riesgo). Por lo tanto, el bendiocarb es el pesticida que representa la mayor preocupación para la salud. Sin embargo, no se deben descartar los otros dos compuestos, ya que puede haber un riesgo acumulado. Esto se debe a que los tres pesticidas pueden afectar el mismo órgano o sistema de órganos.

analysis.research_question_and_background: El estudio aborda el problema de la exposición laboral a pesticidas utilizados en el control de vectores de enfermedades víricas, como el chikungunya, en México, donde estos agentes constituyen un desafío de salud pública. El objetivo es evaluar el riesgo sanitario asociado con el uso de estos pesticidas en el ámbito laboral.
analysis.study_design_and_population: El estudio se enfoca en la evaluación del riesgo de salud por exposición ocupacional a pesticidas utilizados para el control de vectores de enfermedades víricas en México. Se consideraron los principales pesticidas recomendados por el CENAPRECE, incluyendo bendiocarb, bifentrina y pirimifos-metil, que son potencialmente tóxicos para los seres humanos.
analysis.methods: Se identificaron los efectos sobre la salud de los pesticidas considerando su potencial tóxico (pT) y neurotóxico (pNe), así como la dosis de exposición estimada (DEE) en el ámbito laboral, de acuerdo con los años de exposición. Se calculó el riesgo no cancerígeno individual (HQi) y el índice de riesgo (HI) para cada pesticida.
analysis.main_results: El bendiocarb mostró los valores más altos de riesgo de efectos no cancerígenos sobre la salud, con HQ > 1 (riesgo alto) y incrementos significativos de 1.35, 2.7 y 4.1 conforme aumentaron los años de exposición laboral (5, 10 y 15 años, respectivamente). La bifentrina y el pirimifos metil presentaron incrementos proporcionales al tiempo de exposición laboral, pero con valores de HQ < 1 (riesgo bajo).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Los resultados indican que el bendiocarb representa el mayor riesgo para la salud en comparación con los otros dos pesticidas, lo cual es una observación directa basada en los cálculos de riesgo no cancerígeno individual (HQi) y el índice de riesgo (HI).
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Estos hallazgos pueden informar la necesidad de implementar medidas de protección más estrictas para los trabajadores expuestos al bendiocarb, así como guiar la selección de pesticidas en programas de control de vectores de enfermedades víricas en México.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: El estudio se basa en datos abstractos y no proporciona información detallada sobre la metodología o controles utilizados, lo que limita la confianza en los resultados. Sin embargo, los hallazgos son directos y se basan en cálculos de riesgo no cancerígeno individual (HQi) y el índice de riesgo (HI), lo que justifica una evaluación de confianza moderada.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the health risk associated with occupational exposure to pesticides used for vector control in Mexico, focusing on those relevant to chikungunya virus transmission. The research identifies bendiocarb as the pesticide with the highest non-cancerous health risk, based on calculated hazard quotients (HQi) and risk indices (HI), which increase significantly with years of exposure. Bifenthrin and pirimiphos-methyl show proportional increases in risk but remain at lower levels. The findings highlight the need for stricter protective measures for workers exposed to bendiocarb and inform the selection of pesticides in vector control programs. However, the study is limited to abstract-level data, and the evidence is considered moderate in strength due to the lack of detailed methodology and controls.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 我们将通知您对使用双效苯乙威的工人实施保护措施的必要性,并根据墨西哥 媒介 病毒控制计划选择杀虫剂。

title_zh: 估计墨西哥 媒介 控制中使用的农药和农药的健康状况

abstract_zh: 在墨西哥,杀虫剂的使用已被广泛推广,用于控制和防治通过病毒传播的疾病(如基孔肯雅热、登革热、疟疾和寨卡病毒病),这些疾病目前已成为墨西哥的公共卫生问题,而从事这些产品喷洒的劳动者则是暴露风险最高的人群。本研究估算了墨西哥国家预防与疾病控制中心(CENAPRECE)推荐用于控制上述媒介传播疾病且对人类具有潜在毒性的主要杀虫剂(联苯菊酯、甲基嘧啶磷和混灭威)的职业暴露健康风险。为此,研究识别了这些杀虫剂的潜在健康影响,包括其毒性潜力(pT)和神经毒性潜力(pNe),以及根据职业暴露年限估算的暴露剂量(DEE)。研究计算了个体非致癌风险(HQi)和风险指数(HI)。结果显示,混灭威在非致癌健康影响风险方面呈现最高值(HQ > 1 = 高风险),且随着职业暴露年限(5年、10年和15年)的增加,风险值分别显著上升至1.35、2.7和4.1。而联苯菊酯和甲基嘧啶磷则显示出与职业暴露时间成正比的风险增加,但HQ值均<1(低风险)。因此,混灭威是对健康构成最大关注的杀虫剂。然而,不应忽视其他两种化合物,因为可能存在累积风险。这是因为三种杀虫剂可能影响同一器官或系统。

The aims of our case series were to (1) examine the prevalence and frequency of atypical symptoms among patients and (2) ascertain demographic characteristics and concomitant diseases. Case Descriptions Case 1 A 39-year-old male patient presented to the emergency department with complaints of high-grade fever associated with chills for 4 days (103.2 °F). He had associated complaints of vomiting and headache for 4 days, followed by altered sensorium for 1 day. On examination, the patient appeared disoriented and irritable, with GCS being E4V3M6. CNS examination revealed exaggerated bilateral deep tendon reflexes and a positive Babinski reflex; the remaining systemic examination was regular. The laboratory investigation revealed HIV reactive status, with the presence of antichikungunya IgM in serum and CSF (Table 1). An MRI brain Introduction Chikungunya fever (CHIKF) is an arboviral illness induced by the chikungunya virus (CHIKV), an alphavirus belonging to the Togaviridae family. Transmission occurs through a human– mosquito–human cycle initiated by a mosquito bite. Symptoms manifest after 2–6 days of incubation, characterized by high fever and intense arthralgia. Following a quiescent interval of 32 years, CHIKV re-emerged in India in 2005. Every section of the nation has become endemic due to the illness, with outbreaks resulting in severe economic and production losses.1 While chikungunya is often not deemed life-threatening, unusual clinical presentations leading to considerable morbidity have been recorded, particularly during outbreaks. CHIKV infection may lead to severe sickness requiring urgent care, accompanied by considerable death. Source of support: Nil Conflict of interest: None Atypical Presentation of Chikungunya Virus Infection: More Than Meets the Eye Sandesh Sadanand Raut1, Manaswini Edara2, Sachin Shivnitwar3 Received on: 12 December 2024; Accepted on: 27 April 2025; Published on: 15 August 2026 Abstract Background: The recent surge in global chikungunya virus (CHIKV) outbreaks has compelled physicians and epidemiologists to concentrate on atypical symptoms because to their substantial and occasionally fatal consequences. Information regarding the unusual symptoms of CHIKV infection is scarce, with only a handful of solitary case reports and hospital-based studies accessible. A thorough assessment of the atypical symptoms is crucial for understanding the true characteristics of CHIKV infection and its effects on those afflicted. Case descriptions: Cases 1 and 2 presented with neurological manifestations, and MRI in both cases revealed nonspecific findings, which is unusual for chikungunya. Case 3 was observed to have multiple, painful, erythematous papules with hemorrhagic crusting in the bilateral groin along with tongue erosions and oral ulcers, which is often confused for sexually transmitted infections. Similarly, cases 5 and 6 presented with a maculopapular rash. Case 4 had an unusual cardiac presentation as retrosternal pain radiating to the back and bilateral lower limb edema, and she had worsening of her leprosy symptoms. Conclusion: Chikungunya viral infection can have a multitude of presentations, be it cutaneous, neurological, cardiac, or respiratory manifestations. Identifying the symptoms early can help provide timely management and improve overall outcomes. Keywords: Coryza, Lepromatous leprosy, Maculopapular rash, Viral myalgia. Because of low GCS, the patient was intubated, and mechanical ventilation was started (Fig. 2). Case 3 A 29-year-old male patient came to the OPD with complaints of fever, high grade (102 F), which was associated with generalized weakness, myalgia, bilateral wrist tenderness, and pruritus. On examination, the patient was observed to have multiple, painful, erythematous papules with hemorrhagic crusting in the bilateral groin and well-defined erosions present over the tongue with oral ulcers. The laboratory investigation showed a platelet count of 74,000 on admission, and serum antichikungunya IgM was positive. Sexually transmitted diseases were evaluated and ruled out. The patient was treated with supportive treatments; the patient showed significant clinical improvement with healing of the lesions. On follow-up, after 4 weeks, the patient’s skin lesions were completely resolved (Fig. 3). Case 4 A 50-year-old female patient presented to the OPD with complaints of fever and vomiting for 2 days. This was associated with chest pain, retrosternal radiating to the back, and bilateral lower limb edema. She had a known case of lepromatous leprosy with type 2 lepra reaction and systemic hypertension. On examination, the patient had multiple well-defined hyperpigmented patches to papules and nodules over the bilateral upper limb, lower limb, trunk, ears, and abdomen. She also had bilateral ulnar nerve thickening, two fluid-filled bullous lesions over her right foot, along with a tender swelling of the right knee joint. The serum antichikungunya IgM was observed to be positive and associated with thrombocytopenia (79,000/mm3). Subsequently, the patient deteriorated, suspected to be in septic shock (Procalcitonin–50 ng/mL), and was started on inotropes (noradrenaline), IV meropenem 1 gm BD with oxygen support via an NRBM. The patient recovered within 3 weeks and was discharged. Case 5 An 18-year-old female patient came with a fever of 8 days, associated with chills (101 °F on admission), myalgia, arthralgia, and headache. A blanching rash and maculopapular rash on the trunk and back were noted during the examination. The patient screening was performed to confirm the diagnosis, which suggests small vessel ischemic changes (Fig. 1). The patient was treated with IV antibiotics, steroids, and IV acyclovir 500 mg TDS with added supportive care. Due to a decline in GCS, the patient was intubated and maintained on mechanical ventilation, which was started for a drop in GCS. The patient recovered after 10 days. Case 2 A 79-year-old male patient had chief complaints of high-grade fever and arthralgia for the past 7 days. This was associated with a history of altered sensorium and gradually progressive loss of consciousness for 2 days. On examination, the patient was febrile (temperature 102 °F), lethargic, and disoriented with a GCS of E2V4M4. The blanching rash was present all over the body. A neurological examination revealed that deep tendon reflexes were absent and that there was a mute plantar response. The treatment was started with IV antibiotics and IV Hydration. Discussion This series aimed to document the unusual clinical manifestation of CHIK in India (Table 2). Atypical symptoms were seen more often in our case series than prior evidence shows. Fever was the most often reported symptom, accompanied by headache and vomiting. Only a single patient had joint discomfort. Most research indicated that the most frequently reported symptoms of CHIKV infection manifest within minutes to hours following the beginning of fever in 87–99% of patients.79 Joint pain was recorded as the earliest symptom in the Kerala outbreak (2007), with an overall incidence of just 17%, predominantly affecting the elderly (77%) in comparison to younger age groups.10 This may signify a significant alteration in the trend of CHIKV infection and, thus, might be a focal point for future research endeavors. was started on IV antibiotics and IV fluids. Ultrasound of the abdomen was suggestive of bilateral pleural effusion, mild ascites, and hepatomegaly. The serum antidengue IgM and anti-CHIKV IgM came up positive. analysis.research_question_and_background: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection is often considered benign, yet atypical and severe presentations can lead to significant morbidity and mortality during outbreaks. The study aimed to examine the prevalence and frequency of atypical symptoms among patients and to ascertain demographic characteristics and concomitant diseases.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a case series published in the Journal of the Indian Medical Association (August 2026) examining atypical presentations of chikungunya virus infection. The study described demographic characteristics and concomitant diseases among patients presenting with atypical symptoms.
analysis.methods: The study involved detailed clinical case descriptions of patients with atypical chikungunya presentations, including neurological symptoms, laboratory investigations, and imaging where applicable. No specific laboratory methods or statistical analyses were described beyond the use of serum and CSF testing for antichikungunya IgM.
analysis.main_results: One case described a 39-year-old male with high-grade fever, vomiting, headache, and altered sensorium, with neurological examination revealing exaggerated deep tendon reflexes and a positive Babinski reflex. Laboratory findings included HIV reactive status and the presence of antichikungunya IgM in both serum and cerebrospinal fluid.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors highlight that atypical clinical presentations of CHIKV infection can lead to severe morbidity and even mortality, challenging the perception of chikungunya as a benign illness. They emphasize the need for meticulous evaluation of unusual symptoms to better understand CHIKV infection attributes.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the importance of heightened clinical vigilance for atypical chikungunya presentations, particularly in endemic regions, to prevent underdiagnosis and improve patient outcomes.
